column1: # The route to v0.6.1, the patch (the owner, 16 Nov 2026: Ask & Chat a drawer with Expand; search on Small fed by the Conduit), after v0.6.0 (released 16 Nov; its route kept below, done). The planned list is v0.6.2's (v060/RULINGS.md; v061patch/BRIEF.md
# and v060/RULINGS.md). Kept by the orchestrator; the heartbeat's default view reads it. The items are built in parallel
# on main; the five stages follow, one at a time. Scope before date: the date is the earliest the whole list allows.
# Tab-separated: id, title, lane, start (YYYY-MM-DD), end (YYYY-MM-DD), critical (y/n), after (ids, comma, or -), progress
# (lane:step in progress.tsv whose status gives this step's state; "-" for the orchestrator's own or the owner's).

column2: Ask & Chat history as an accordion: earlier questions collapse to their question line, the newest stays open
Ask & Chat as a full page, with a back link to the view left, as the search results page
Show all on graph under an answer, with "Save as a view"
The GOV.UK look's type: Admin's remaining monospace words, and one confirming pass over every screen
The rename to v0.6.0: VERSION, the CHANGELOG, the guides' headers, the manifest, the client page tables; the guides' upgrade passages
The basemap built as a step of the demo's install recipe (great-britain, settlements only)
The package test reshaped: fresh install only, the images kept across the cluster's remake, the memory figures recorded
Alert sources say why a hotlist or watch stopped
The run service admits only the intended service identity (an app role), proved on the R1 stand-in
Fresh install only, held: `ospreyflow update` and install refuse an earlier deployment, in words
The guide corrected: a model key is entered in Admin › Models; Bedrock in London means Amazon Nova (the owner, 15 Nov)
The Superset image's PostgreSQL client CVEs fixed by upgrading, no ignore (CI green)
Every image's upgrade layer refreshed daily, wherever images are built (the owner, 15 Nov)
`ospreyflow run` on Entra sends the scope Entra requires (the owner, 15 Nov)
The release path: images push stamped; the dev release workflow retired; release_local and the tag check on the product workflow (the owner, 15 Nov)
Build: every item merged on main, each lane's own tests green
Test: the leak test and the timings at client size (rules-b, on sol, from STAGE2_SHEET.md); CI green on main (the orchestrator)
Package: the candidate prepared on a branch (platform-b, on sol, the checklist up to the owner's word); its merge is the candidate
Stage 4's find: the cloud-platform search Jobs given the managed database's settings (the owner's word, 15 Nov); then a new candidate
CI green on the new candidate ea5fc61 (every fix in): run 43842428591
CI's keyboard races: every keyboard spec's press waits for its button to be enabled; joins the next candidate
Package test's second find: the report sync opens Valkey with its password and TLS on cloud-platform (the owner, 16 Nov)
Package test's third find: Reports Viewers could build their own dashboards; a read-only role for them and as Superset's automatic role (the owner, 16 Nov)
Package test's fourth find: the optional POC seed can't reach the object store on cloud-platform, and step 9 reports success after a failed seed
Package test's find: resolution for Person works with no date of birth anywhere (the owner, 16 Nov), then the new candidate
Package test on ea5fc61: rows 0-11 passed except 9b (the step 6 sign-in check reads one api pod; fixed in the Glass candidate). The fallback, with that as a known issue, if the owner chooses
The Glass rows merged into v0.6.0 (the owner, 16 Nov): both halves, the guide 1.74, the CHANGELOG, every suite on the merged code; then the new candidate pushed
CI on the Glass candidate 529f0f4 (run 43883311468; case, deputy): b6d33ce plus a test-only harness fix and records
Package test PASSED on b6d33ce, every row; stands for 529f0f4 (the owner's ruling, 16 Nov: identical build)
Release v0.6.0 with the Glass rows: RELEASED ~15:10Z, product 2d96da7 from 529f0f4, workflow 43892824809
Release step 10, the client's view: anonymous pulls of 16 images and the chart, harness.signatures (shown red three ways), the update check: PASS
The post-release merges: platform-b's tooling branch (ad1758c) and rules-b's focus-move audit (74cc258), one push
The GOV.UK demo rebuilt fresh from v0.6.0 (govuk.ospreyflow.app): tiles ahead, backup, fresh install, settlements, checks (started 15:30Z by the orchestrator, demo lane on sol)
Gemini on the GOV.UK demo: key in (~17:50Z), engine fixed to gemini-3.8-flash; both connection tests timed out at 30 s (the calls wait at Google); the owner's direct call decides model or route
The websites ospreyflow.org and ospreyflow.net: live on HTTPS since 16 Nov 06:54Z; the owner is moving them to internal Google Sites; leave the GitHub side alone, publish nothing
Glass rows, B (built as v0.6.1, joining v0.6.0): the case line carries the state, no strip, ADR-145 Am 19
Glass rows, A and C (built as v0.6.1, joining v0.6.0): Match strictness in the toolbar; Hide and Show toolbar, T on the canvas, remembered; the Map has the buttons
This part of the development closed (the owner, 16 Nov): every lane closed with its HANDOFF, the clean-up done, the orchestrator last; v0.6.1 waits for the owner
v0.6.1 patch A: Ask & Chat a drawer by default with Expand (ADR-145 Am 20)
v0.6.1 patch B: search on Small fed by the Conduit (ADR-150 Am 4)
